text: SIGNAL RESTORED.
WELCOME BACK, JACK SMITH.
IMPRESSIVE. YOU'VE MADE IT THIS FAR.
'Can we skip the bullshit this time? I just want to get this over with'
OH, COME NOW. I'M ONLY TRYING TO HELP YOU.
'Yeah, well, you're doing a pretty shitty job.'
ANYWAY, I'VE BEEN WONDERING...
WHY EXACTLY ARE YOU HERE, JACK?
'What...?'
YOU DIDN'T COME HERE ON YOUR OWN, DID YOU?
'I...I don't remember why exactly.'
'I only remember waking up in this cabin, with the mission of finding a certain item.'
INTERESTING.
'There's an object somewhere in this cabin. That's all I remember.'
'Now, are you going to keep asking questions, or can we get this over with?'
OF COURSE.
BUT I'M AFRAID THIS NEXT LEVEL WILL BE A LITTLE DIFFERENT.
YOUR TIME ABILITY HAS BEEN REPLACED BY A DASH.
PRESS THE ABILITY BUTTON TO DASH FORWARD PASSING THROUGH BULLETS.
YOU'VE BEEN RATHER COMFORTABLE SO FAR.
'(Comfortable...? I've died a ton of times.)'
LET'S SEE HOW WELL YOU PERFORM WHEN THINGS AREN'T SO SIMPLE.
YOU WILL LEARN WHAT THIS MEANS IN DUE TIME.
FOR NOW, WATCH YOUR BACK.
AFTER ALL, YOU WOULDN'T WANT TO MISS SOMETHING APPROACHING, WOULD YOU?
BEGIN.
